company_profile.tech_level: Moderate - Dentally for practice management, basic digital workflows
company_profile.description: Multi-location dental practice with 3 sites across London, employing 35 staff including 8 dentists, 6 hygienists, and 21 support staff. Offers NHS and private treatments with a growing focus on cosmetic dentistry. Known for patient care quality but struggling with administrative efficiency and patient retention across locations.

executive_summary.key_insight: Bright Smile Dental Group is losing an estimated £120K+ annually to no-shows, missed recare appointments, and administrative inefficiency. With 3 locations, the lack of automated patient communication and centralised workflows creates compounding losses. Your Dentally platform provides a solid foundation for AI-powered automation that can recover most of this lost revenue within 6-12 months.

not_recommended.title: Full Practice Management Replacement
not_recommended.reason: Dentally is well-suited for multi-site practices and has strong API support. Migrating to a new PMS would cost £15K-£30K in setup, training, and lost productivity. Enhance what you have instead.

not_recommended.title: Custom Patient Portal Build
not_recommended.reason: At 3 locations, maintaining a bespoke patient portal is not cost-effective. Dentally's patient portal and third-party solutions cover 90% of needs.

not_recommended.title: In-House AI Chatbot Development
not_recommended.reason: Building a dental-specific chatbot from scratch requires significant NLP training on clinical terminology. Specialist dental AI vendors have this solved already.

verdict.headline: Strong Candidate for AI-Powered Growth
verdict.subheadline: Your multi-site setup amplifies the ROI of every automation you implement

findings.title: 12% Patient No-Show Rate Costs £45K+ Annually
findings.description: Across 3 locations, an average of 12% of booked appointments result in no-shows. With an average appointment value of £95 (blended NHS/private) and approximately 4,000 appointments per month across all sites, this equates to roughly 480 missed appointments monthly and over £45K in lost revenue per year. The current reminder system relies on a single SMS sent 48 hours before the appointment. Industry best practice uses multi-channel AI reminders (SMS, email, WhatsApp) at multiple touchpoints, which can reduce no-shows by 50-60%.
sources: British Dental Association practice management survey

findings.title: Insurance & NHS Verification Wastes 10+ Hours Per Week
findings.description: Reception staff spend an average of 20 minutes per patient manually verifying insurance eligibility and NHS exemption status. With approximately 200 patients per week requiring verification across 3 locations, this consumes over 66 hours of reception time monthly. Staff must navigate multiple portals (NHSBSA Compass, private insurer websites) and manually update Dentally records. AI-powered verification can automate 80% of routine checks, reducing verification time to under 3 minutes per patient.
sources: Dental insurance processing benchmarks - Dental Plan Direct

findings.title: 55% Treatment Plan Acceptance Rate Leaves Revenue on the Table
findings.description: Only 55% of presented treatment plans are accepted, compared to industry top-performers achieving 75-85%. For Bright Smile, this gap represents approximately £180K in annual unaccepted treatment value. The current process has no systematic follow-up: once a patient declines or says 'I'll think about it,' there is no automated nurture sequence. Research shows that 30% of initially declined plans are accepted within 90 days when followed up with educational content and gentle reminders.

value_created.description: Additional revenue from improved treatment plan acceptance

sources: Dental treatment plan acceptance benchmarks - Practice Growth Solutions
Patient decision-making research - Journal of Dental Practice Management

findings.title: Hygiene Recare Gaps Cost £35K/Year in Missed Appointments
findings.description: Approximately 25% of patients due for hygiene recare appointments are overdue by 3+ months. With 2,800 active hygiene patients across 3 locations and an average hygiene visit value of £65, each month of overdue patients represents significant lost revenue. The current recall system in Dentally sends a single automated reminder, but patients who don't respond receive no follow-up. Practices using AI-driven multi-touch recall systems recover 40-50% of lapsed patients.
sources: Hygiene recare benchmarking - Dental Hygiene Association UK

findings.title: Reception Team Overwhelmed - 40% of Calls Are Routine Queries
findings.description: Reception staff across 3 locations handle an estimated 350+ calls per day, of which approximately 40% (140 calls) are routine enquiries: opening hours, directions, appointment availability, pricing, and NHS eligibility questions. Each call averages 3-4 minutes, consuming 7-9 hours of staff time daily across all sites. During peak hours, 15-20% of calls go unanswered, leading to lost bookings. An AI phone bot can handle 80% of routine queries, freeing reception for complex patient needs and reducing missed calls to near zero.

recommendations.title: Deploy AI Patient Communication System
recommendations.description: Implement an AI-powered patient communication platform that handles appointment reminders, recall campaigns, treatment plan follow-ups, and recare notifications across all 3 locations. The system should integrate with Dentally and use multi-channel delivery (SMS, email, WhatsApp) with personalised messaging and intelligent timing.

why_it_matters.customer_value: Patients receive timely, personalised reminders through their preferred channel. No more missed appointments or forgotten follow-ups. Better care continuity builds trust.
why_it_matters.business_health: Directly addresses 3 of 5 findings: no-shows (£45K), recare gaps (£35K), and treatment plan follow-up (£54K potential). Single platform, one integration, triple impact.

risk.mitigation: Set communication frequency caps per patient and allow preference management via patient portal
Use Dentally's consent flags to ensure only opted-in patients receive automated messages. Audit quarterly.

risk.description: WhatsApp Business API cost at scale
risk.mitigation: Start with SMS/email, add WhatsApp for high-value treatment plan follow-ups only

recommendations.title: Implement AI Reception & Phone Bot
recommendations.description: Deploy an AI-powered phone and messaging system that handles routine patient enquiries (opening hours, directions, appointment availability, pricing, NHS eligibility), takes bookings, and triages urgent calls to human staff. Operates 24/7 across all 3 locations with a single system.

why_it_matters.customer_value: Patients get instant answers any time of day, including evenings and weekends. No more being put on hold or calls going to voicemail. Online booking becomes effortless.
why_it_matters.business_health: Frees reception team to focus on in-practice patient experience. Eliminates 15-20% of missed calls that currently result in lost bookings. One system serves all 3 locations.

risk.description: Patients may dislike speaking to an AI
risk.mitigation: Always offer immediate transfer to a human. Position as 'assistant' not replacement. Use natural-sounding voice.
Train the bot to escalate any clinical or emergency queries to staff immediately. Never provide clinical advice.

Start with one location to prove the model, then roll out to all three.

recommendations.title: Automate Treatment Plan Follow-up & Nurturing
recommendations.description: Implement a systematic treatment plan follow-up workflow that automatically nurtures patients who haven't accepted proposed treatment. The system sends educational content, cost breakdowns, financing options, and gentle reminders at optimised intervals over 90 days.

why_it_matters.customer_value: Patients receive helpful information to make informed decisions about their dental health. No pressure - just education and availability. Financing options make treatment accessible.
why_it_matters.business_health: Improving treatment acceptance from 55% to 70% would recover an estimated £50K+ annually in currently declined treatments. Systematic follow-up removes reliance on individual staff remembering to chase.

risk.description: Patients perceive follow-up as pushy sales
risk.mitigation: Focus on educational content, not hard sells. Include easy opt-out. Space messages appropriately (weekly max).

The analytics alone will reveal which treatments and which messaging approaches work best across your 3 locations.

200+ treatment plans presented monthly across 3 locations
